systems.system: National unified real estate number database (Law 88 of 2025)
systems.country_label: قاعدة بيانات الرقم القومى الموحد للعقارات
systems.platform: Unified Base Map / spatial information infrastructure
systems.owner: CAPMAS with the Military Survey Department
systems.tiers: state authorities, bodies providing public services or running public utilities (Art. 7)

note: Act (Law 88 of 2025, in force 18 June 2025) is a one-sector property identifier law: it obliges state bodies to deal with property through the unified number (Art. 7) and public and private bodies to supply CAPMAS data (Art. 8), but is not a general law on public bodies sharing data, so class other and no fact.
